description: Ask a natural-language question about the content of any URL and receive an AI-generated answer via the OpenGraph.io API. Optionally pass a responseStructure schema to extract structured data. Note: uses 100 API credits per request (or 200 with a large model). Query API remains on v1.1 until the billing path check is updated for v3.

accept_lang.description: Accept-Language header for the outbound request. Defaults to 'auto'.

ai_sanitize.description: Scan the fetched content for prompt-injection attempts.

ai_sanitize_mode.description: 'sanitize' cleans the content, 'warn' returns a safety report, 'block' returns HTTP 422 when risk_score >= 0.7.

auto_render.description: Automatically detect and switch to headless rendering for SPA pages.

cache_ok.description: Use cached page results. Set to false to bypass cache. Defaults to true.

full_render.description: Fully render the page with JavaScript before querying.

max_cache_age.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds. Defaults to 432000000 (5 days).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (1–4). Defaults to 4.

modelSize.description: AI model size. 'small' uses 100 credits; 'large' uses 200 credits. Defaults to 'small'.

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for geo-targeted proxy exit node.

query.description: Natural-language question to answer about the page content.

responseStructure.description: Optional JSON schema describing the shape of the desired response. When provided, the model returns a structured JSON answer.

url.description: URL of the webpage to query.

use_premium.description: Route the request through a premium proxy.

use_proxy.description: Route the request through a standard proxy.

use_superior.description: Route the request through a superior-tier proxy.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before querying.

name: getOgQuery

result.description: AI-generated answer. May be a string or structured object.
